children: Wolfspeed disclosed unaudited pro forma financials reflecting emergence from Chapter 11, a $2.6B enterprise value and $757.1M total stockholders' equity.
Pro forma info gives effect to Plan effective Sept 29, 2025, fresh start accounting and Regulatory Approvals received Jan 29, 2026.
Company estimated enterprise value of $2,600.0M and total stockholders' equity of $757.1M as of the Plan Effective Date.
Issued ~43.56M shares of New Common Stock; old common canceled and prior holders received ~1.31M new shares.
Debt restructuring: New Senior Secured Notes ($1.3B), New 2L Convertible Notes and New 2L Takeback Notes issued; various prior indentures terminated.
Pro forma net loss of $665.9M for year ended June 28, 2026, or ($14.44) per share, reflecting fresh-start and transaction adjustments.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
